meta.name: resolving-merge-conflicts
meta.description: Use when you need to resolve an in-progress git merge/rebase conflict.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解决代码合并时的冲突
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在合并或变基时遇到冲突需要解决
copy.tagline_en: Resolve merge conflicts in your code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter conflicts during git merge or rebase

howto.what: Claude 会帮你分析冲突文件、理解变更意图、逐块解决冲突，然后运行自动化检查并完成合并或变基。
howto.when: 当你正在进行 git merge 或 rebase 并遇到冲突时，可以请求 Claude 协助解决。

say.text: 帮我解决当前分支的合并冲突。
say.note: Claude 会查看冲突文件并开始处理。

say.text: 这个 rebase 冲突怎么解决？
say.note: Claude 会分析冲突并给出解决方案。

howto.what_en: Claude will analyze conflicting files, understand the intent of each change, resolve each hunk, run automated checks, and complete the merge or rebase.
howto.when_en: When you are in the middle of a git merge or rebase with conflicts and ask for help.

say_en.text: Help me resolve the merge conflicts in the current branch.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect the conflicting files and start resolving.

say_en.text: How do I resolve this rebase conflict?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the conflict and suggest a resolution.
